Tests with controlled late revocation, added MFA requirement, expiry, database failure and interruption withhold rows, preserve failure classification and make no implicit retry.
limits: The eleven tests are domain/fake-repository checks, not actual HTTP, concurrent PostgreSQL writes or native provider acceptance. Actual bounded directory PostgreSQL checks are recorded separately.
No device, room, transport, worker or push grant may be minted from this short contact-read observation. Their admission and stable identity migration remain required.
The new space policy has no environment/DI binding or administration UI in this increment. It is not enabled in the live pilot.
